PORT=3123 node .output/server/index.mjs &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 1.5

echo "--- Creating order ---"

echo "$ORDER_RESP"

ORDER_ID=$(echo "$ORDER_RESP" | grep -o '"id":"[^"]*' | cut -d'"' -f4)
echo "Order ID is: $ORDER_ID"

if [ -n "$ORDER_ID" ]; then
  echo "--- Fetching order ---"
  curl -s http://localhost:3123/api/orders/$ORDER_ID
fi

kill $SERVER_PID
